images.caption: The Outenqiua Transport Museum situated in George in the Western Cape, is home to South Africa's only traveling steam train. In days gone by steam trains were the desired mode of transport and at the Outeniqua Transport Museum the visitor is transported back in time, to the realm of locomotive history. On display at the museum is a collection of century old locomotives, vintage cars and Paul Kruger's very own train coach. The Outeniqua Choo-tjoe takes its travelers along a scenic trail route between George and Mossel Bay, where it breaks at the Dias Monument Complex. Currently negotiations are underway to convert the stream train into a diesel locomotive as the area it tours is environmentally sensitive and prone to veld fires.
